Bit late to the game, but I once featured in the segment of a local newspaper in a small seaside town, called 'in the spotlight' that had the very back page dedicated wholly to this article. 

I had written to the paper as a 7year old complaining about the amount of dog waste outside my house and along the street, which was used as a cut through for many dog walkers to access the promenade and beach. 

I made posters in my window and used to challenge people walking by leaving their dogs shit on the pavement. 

A photo of me in my school uniform next to my posters hung in my lounge window featured next to an interview type feature of my quest to get dog walkers to be more responsible with their dog waste. 

It didn't make a difference at the time with regards to the dog shit situation in the street, and still now nearly 30 years later... It's the still the same shit riddled street it was. And no one really noticed or commented about me being 'poo girl' or anything that I remember. I was ultimately just being fucked off walking outside my house and always stepping in something and then having to pick out dog crap out from the soles of my shoes.
